candidate.answerReason: Orthographic projection preserves the length of a segment parallel to the projection plane, so the projected length is 6 cm.

methods.label: Length preservation
methods.explanation: When a segment is parallel to the projection plane, its orthographic projection is parallel and equal in length to the original segment, so its length remains 6 cm.
methods.levelReason: The length-preservation property for this segment position belongs to Grade 9 orthographic projection.
